title: peak-auto-lr/1: the peaks of `mzlab-cli peak auto-lr`
description: Every peak of a low-resolution (SIM/MRM) trace found by the engine, the same bytes as the page's «Integrate every peak shown». The parameters used are named like `--set` (`half`, `valley` as a fraction of the height, `sn`, `min_pts`, `despike`); the old dialog names `lr_*` still work as `--set` aliases and log a note on stderr. Unlike `peak-auto/1` the document has no `schema` field, because the page prints the same bytes. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/peaks_auto_lr_cmd.rs, crates/mzlab-core/src/peakq_lrauto_json.rs.

half.description: Half window of the Savitzky-Golay smoothing of the detection copy, points (--set half; 0 chooses it from the FWHM of the tallest peak).

half_auto.description: True when the half window was chosen here (it was not set).

valley.description: Two maxima stay two peaks only when the smaller rises above the valley by this fraction of its own height (--set valley takes the fraction; the old lr_valley took %).

sn.description: Smallest height over the noise for a peak (--set sn; old name lr_sn).

min_pts.description: Minimum points in a peak (--set min_pts).

despike.description: Median of 3 before the smoothing, so single-point spikes never become peaks (--set despike).

baseline.description: Always `engine`: this route never reads a baseline setting.

noise.description: MAD noise of the raw trace, counts.

lo.description: Index of the first point of the peak in the trace.

hi.description: Index of the last point of the peak.

area.description: Area above the baseline line, counts x s (counts x min with --area-unit min); never negative.

below.description: The part of the trace under the baseline line that was cut off, same unit as area.

area_zero.description: Area above zero, same unit as area.

sn.description: Height of the smoothed peak above the background over the noise.

end0.description: How the left end was found: the smoothed trace came down to the background (or the trace ended); the valley shared with the neighbour; the walk stopped at 5 FWHM from the apex, still above the background.

clamp0.description: What the clamp did to b0: none; lowered onto the trace; raised to zero.
